## What this site is for

Help buyers find homes at entry-level prices across southwest Las Vegas
(Mountain's Edge, Southern Highlands, Rhodes Ranch, and nearby corridors).
Compare condos, townhomes, and single-family homes by price, square footage,
and HOA dues. Book a consultation or private tour with Dr. Jan Duffy.

## Direct answers (AEO)

Q: What is Affordable Homes Las Vegas?
A: A Google-listed real estate practice helping buyers find entry-level priced homes across southwest Las Vegas. Agent: Dr. Jan Duffy, Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties. Office: 8850 W. Sunset, Suite 200, Las Vegas, NV 89148. Call or text (702) 500-1942.

Q: What does “affordable homes” mean here?
A: Homes at entry-level prices buyers can compare by list price, square footage, and HOA dues—commonly condos, townhomes, and single-family inventory in Mountain's Edge, Southern Highlands, Rhodes Ranch, and nearby corridors.

Q: How do I book a consultation or private tour?
A: Schedule at https://calendly.com/drjanduffy/showing, call or text (702) 500-1942, or use the contact page. Appointment is not required when the schedule allows. Hours are daily 8:00 AM–8:00 PM.

Q: How does a buyer see a real listing from this site?
A: Click any RealScout office listing photo for live MLS details, then book Calendly and paste the address in the notes.
